# InkMagnet

> InkMagnet is an AI ebook generator that delivers a finished, professionally typeset book, not chat text. Describe a topic; you get a free title, editable table of contents and a two-page typeset sample before paying. After you approve the plan, InkMagnet researches the topic on the live web, writes the book chapter by chapter, runs a language edit and a whole-book consistency check, designs a cover, and exports a print-ready PDF and an EPUB. One fixed price per book, no subscription. Built in Poland; writes natively in Polish and English.

## What makes it different

- A finished book, not text: LaTeX typesetting (clickable table of contents, running heads, hyphenation, drop caps, tables, tip/warning boxes), a cover designed for that book, PDF + EPUB.
- Grounded content: web research before writing; citations/footnotes point to real sources.
- Language editing on every book: per-chapter proofreading plus a whole-book consistency pass (names, numbers, cross-references between chapters).
- See it before paying: free title + table of contents (editable, one AI redo, choose between versions) and a free 2-page sample typeset exactly like the final book.
- No subscription: pay per book. Full commercial rights, no watermark.
- Native Polish: Polish typography („…” quotes, en dashes, hyphenation). Written in Polish, not translated. Made by a Polish proofreader/editor.
- Edit after generation: WYSIWYG chapter editor, add your own photos, recompile any time. Android app available.

## Pricing (one-time, per book)

- Compact, 30–45 pages: $9.99
- Standard, 46–75 pages: $14.99
- Extended, 76–115 pages: $19.99
- Comprehensive, 116–160 pages: $27.99
- Complete, 161–200 pages: $34.99
- Polish prices are shown in PLN at the current NBP exchange rate.

## Typical uses

- Lead magnets (ebook for a newsletter sign-up) for small businesses, coaches and consultants
- Course companion books and training materials
- Expert books and practical guides
- Ebooks to sell on your own store, Kindle or Apple Books

## FAQ

- Is there a free trial? The title, table of contents and a 2-page typeset sample are free; you pay only for the finished book.
- Which languages? Polish and English, each written natively.
- Who owns the book? You do, with full commercial rights and no watermark.
- How long does it take? Typically under an hour from approving the plan to a finished PDF and EPUB.
